faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist recruitment is 02-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Principal Project Scientist position is a PhD in the power systems area. Candidates must possess this qualification to be considered for the role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Principal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Principal Project Scientist post at IIT Delhi. This recruitment drive aims to fill this single position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Principal Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Principal Project Scientist post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 75600 to Rs. 101610 per month, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Principal Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Principal Project Scientist role will involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110016.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITD/IRD/219/2026. This number should be referenced when applying.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job. The position of Principal Project Scientist is offered on a contractual basis.
